Delete Your Account

Last updated: June 2026

You can request deletion of your Linq account and all associated data at any time. Once deleted, your data cannot be recovered.

What gets deleted

  • Your profile (name, avatar, preferences)
  • Your stamp cards and loyalty progress
  • Your transaction history
  • Your account credentials

Option 1 — Delete from the app

  1. Open the Linq app
  2. Go to your Profile
  3. Tap Settings
  4. Select Delete Account and confirm

Option 2 — Request by email

If you cannot access the app, email us and we will delete your account within 30 days.
